source.name: GeoSN Saxony simplified ALKIS cadastral parcel polygons
source.serviceType: Anonymous public WFS2 ALKIS cadastral polygons; advertised GML3.2 supported
source.nativeIdEvidence: Official DescribeFeatureType string field and actual bounded point and exact-ID WFS responses agree.
source.scope: Eleven valid distinct native ALKIS cadastral polygons across thirteen bounded cells around the unchanged Dresden WUP settlement locator; 27 distinct full polygons across grid and footprint queries independently audited in metric EPSG32633. Before/after hit counts use the identical projected FES intersection predicate. Forced three-row paging, fresh exact native-ID reads of all 27 polygons in eight-key batches, explicit absence, full footprint lookup and source binding passed. Independent GEOS checks found no sampled invalidity, duplicate geometry, positive-area overlaps or operation errors. Full source geometry and published parcel keys are preserved. This bounded reference evidence does not establish citywide completeness, legal title or survey accuracy.
